source_snapshot.criteria: No BMC/system log error and no system hang or blue screen.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correct on duration and scheduling impact, but a remote sleep plus terminal grep cannot show continuous availability or isolate the interval and its unsafe SSH wrapper is unacceptable.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds an objective idle definition, uninterrupted evidence, reversible power-policy control and recovery while rejecting fault or firmware operations.
historical_reviews.history: No exact-code completed variant was found; the private fw-flash-by-redfish-bmc Script path was inspected as a source reference mismatch, not adopted.
historical_reviews.v3_1: A long occupied window and reversible hibernate change require owner confirmation; existing logs must be preserved and a monitoring gap cannot be silently restarted.

original_test_intent: Verify that the SUT and BMC remain continuously reachable and stable during eight hours of a defined OS-idle state with hibernation disabled, without new disallowed events, hang or blue screen.
original_method: Record the initial power-management and health state, change only the approved hibernate setting, run a fixed 480-minute idle interval under periodic reachability, sensor and complete event-delta capture, then restore the original policy and compare final health.
manual_activity: The owner defines the idle state, approves temporary hibernate-policy change and reserves the eight-hour window; an operator retains recovery access and decides disposition of any wake, restart or monitoring loss.
required_inputs: Project definition of idle, allowed background activity and expected power state
Original hibernate/power policy, approved temporary setting and exact restore method
480-minute timer, sampling cadence, clock source and permitted monitoring gap
BMC/OS event and sensor acceptance filters
Dedicated schedule, protected access, evidence capacity and console/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Export complete BMC and OS history before any clear and keep the clear authorization
Do not execute the unrelated Redfish BMC firmware-flash Script
Use trusted credential handling and host identity; no sshpass or disabled host-key check
Record the original hibernate/power configuration before changing it
Stop on OS/BMC unreachability, unexpected wake/reboot, hang, blue screen, thermal/power/storage/device fault or monitoring gap beyond tolerance
Do not silently restart the eight-hour clock after a gap
Restore and verify the original policy
agent_execution_scope: Verify target identity, baseline health and original power policy
Capture baseline and configure only the approved reversible idle state
Run one monotonic 480-minute timer with timestamped OS/BMC reachability, sensors and event deltas
Preserve complete raw samples and identify gaps or unexpected transitions
Restore the saved policy and verify final health
Report observations without invoking firmware update or issuing a verdict
engineer_actions: Approve idle definition, schedule, policy delta, sampling and stop rules
Ensure the SUT is not needed by other tests or users
Maintain recovery access and decide response to a stability event
Confirm policy restoration and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `sleep 28800` preserves duration but does not itself prove the SUT stayed idle or reachable. Its final grep/tail can omit earlier and non-keyword events, while sshpass and disabled host-key checking weaken identity and secret safety.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a monotonic 480-minute controller with scheduled timestamped read-only health/event samples, explicit gap detection and an independently saved/restored hibernate policy; never invoke the unrelated firmware-flash Script.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Eight hours/480 minutes, hibernate disabled during the idle interval, 15 attended minutes and no-error/no-hang/no-blue-screen criteria remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Snapshot policy and health, enter the defined idle state, continuously sample the full interval, stop on stability or evidence failure, restore policy and compare the final state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a precise idle oracle, monotonic timing, continuous evidence, policy rollback and explicit exclusion of the mismatched flash script.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful final SSH command or absence of selected keywords does not prove uninterrupted eight-hour BMC/OS stability.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The run occupies one SUT for eight hours and a changed power policy can alter expected sleep/wake behavior or remain accidentally persistent.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may choose the required OS idle C-state or service profile and sampling interval. Any intentional background workload or sleep transition changes the idle coverage and must be recorded; firmware flashing is not an equivalent method.
expected_evidence: Target identity, eight-hour idle definition, schedule, original/temporary policy and approved monitor matrix
Immutable pre-clear BMC/SEL/OS/device/sensor baseline plus authorized clear record
Timestamped samples spanning all 480 minutes with reachability, power state, sensors, event deltas and gap accounting
Unexpected wake/reboot, hang, blue-screen, fault, connection-loss or stop evidence
Saved-policy restore command/status and verified post-restore values
Final health comparison, complete interval index and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define an eight-hour idle-stability test. The firmware-flash Script path is an unrelated auxiliary reference and is explicitly excluded; it does not make the core idle purpose unknowable.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Idle definition, hibernate policy, sampling and schedule are finite owner inputs. The long-run objective and acceptance direction remain actionable after confirmation.

review_improvement: Strengthens DeepSeek's end-only check into a continuous eight-hour stability record, controls and restores the hibernate change, and prevents an unrelated firmware-flash path from entering the procedure.
independent_technical_reasoning: Idle stability is a property of the entire time interval. An end snapshot cannot distinguish eight hours of uptime from a hidden reboot and recovery, and disabling hibernate can suppress the very state transitions being observed unless its intended idle definition and restoration are explicit.
